items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: it's under the Cozy Cole All Stars in February of '44 with Joe Thomas the trumpeter, Tommy Young

ctx.x: My first record date ever was with under my name was with Harry Lim. He is the one that sponsored it.

Curiously, that's not listed. The first one listed in Jeffson, it's under the Cozy Cole All Stars in February of '44 with Joe Thomas the trumpeter, Tommy Young, Coleman Hawkins, Earl Hines, Teddy Walters and Billy Taylor.
That's the same date, I think.
